From: ncse-membe...@st-andrews.ac.uk <ncse-membe...@st-andrews.ac.uk> on behalf of Paul Blackwell <p.bla...@sheffield.ac.uk>
Sent: Thursday, April 13, 2023 09:36
To: 'ncse...@st-andrews.ac.uk' <ncse...@st-andrews.ac.uk>
Subject: [ncse-members] [ncse-all] PhD: Using ensemble models to explore ecosystem effects of management actions, Sheffield & Cefas
 
We are currently advertising a PhD project on statistical multi-model
ensemble methods applied to marine ecosystems, based in Maths & Stats in
Sheffield and supervised by me and by Mike Spence and Chris Lynam at the
Centre for Environment, Fisheries and Aquaculture Science. The project
would start in October 2023; the closing date for applications is 8th
May 2023.

Details at
https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/acce-dtp-studentship-using-ensemble-models-to-explore-ecosystem-effects-of-management-actions/?p148903

This is a re-advertisement due to new funding (for UK students only)
becoming available.

Paul.

--
Professor P. G. Blackwell
School of Mathematics & Statistics, University of Sheffield
